name: unicode.utf16
doc:
unicode.utf16: UTF-16 encoding and decoding of code points
(Go's unicode/utf16). Unpaired surrogates decode to U+FFFD.

items.name: AppendRune
items.doc: Appends the encoding of r to u.
items.summary: Appends the encoding of r to u.

items.name: Decode
items.doc: The code points of a UTF-16 sequence.
items.summary: The code points of a UTF-16 sequence.

items.name: DecodeRune
items.signature: func DecodeRune(r1 char, r2 char) char
items.doc: The code point of a surrogate pair, or U+FFFD if it is not one.
items.summary: The code point of a surrogate pair, or U+FFFD if it is not one.

items.name: Encode
items.doc: The UTF-16 encoding of the code points (invalid ones become U+FFFD).
items.summary: The UTF-16 encoding of the code points (invalid ones become U+FFFD).

items.name: EncodeRune
items.doc:
The surrogate pair of r, or (U+FFFD, U+FFFD) if r is not above U+FFFF
or not valid.
items.summary: The surrogate pair of r, or (U+FFFD, U+FFFD) if r is not above U+FFFF or not valid.

items.name: IsSurrogate
items.doc: True if r is a surrogate half (U+D800..U+DFFF).
items.summary: True if r is a surrogate half (U+D800..U+DFFF).

items.name: RuneLen
items.doc: Number of 16-bit units needed for r (1 or 2), or -1 if invalid.
items.summary: Number of 16-bit units needed for r (1 or 2), or -1 if invalid.
